details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a clear structure covering revenue, segment performance, profitability, expenses, assets/equity, and outlook. Most statements logically connect: revenue growth (S1) is explained by fibreboard segment performance (S2-S3), profitability deterioration (S5) is quantified (S6-S8) and explained by shutdown and energy costs (S9-S10), and financial positions are consistently presented (S11-S15). There are no self-contradictions, organizational confusion, or material repetitions. The summary forms a coherent narrative despite this one analytical gap.
